gog.store_details: This is the original 2000 Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn with its Throne of Bhaal expansion, not 2013's 'Enhanced Edition'. GOG stopped selling it by November 2016 (per GOG's forums), but it's still an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Baldur's Gate II ships with 'Environmental Audio' unset and only turns it on by itself the first time it starts with EAX available.

sources.title: GOG forum: BGEE, BG2EE, IWEE vs originals
